title: Turkey Stuffed Peppers
shortDescription: Colorful bell peppers filled with lean turkey, quinoa, and tomato
subtitle: Colorful bell peppers filled with lean turkey, quinoa, and tomato
description: Bell peppers bake filled with ground turkey, cooked quinoa, diced tomato, and spices until tender and topped with melted cheese.

steps.title: Cook turkey filling
steps.instruction: Brown ground turkey with onion in olive oil over medium-high 8–10 minutes until crumbly and no pink remains. Add garlic, tomato paste, seasoning.

steps.title: Combine with quinoa
steps.instruction: Stir in cooked quinoa, diced tomatoes, and salt. Mix until filling looks moist and holds together when pressed, not crumbly or dry.

steps.title: Stuff peppers
steps.instruction: Fill each pepper with ¾ cup filling, packing lightly. Stand upright in a baking dish with ½ cup broth in bottom to steam during bake.

steps.title: Bake covered then uncovered
steps.instruction: Cover with foil, bake at 375°F 30 minutes. Uncover, top with cheese, bake 12–15 more minutes until peppers tender and cheese melted.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.instruction: Rest 5 minutes. Pepper walls should yield to a fork but hold shape; filling should be hot throughout with no pink turkey.

proTips: Mix red, yellow, and orange peppers for visual appeal at the line.
Vegetarian version: swap turkey for extra quinoa and black beans.
Reheat covered with splash of broth to restore moisture.
leftovers: Chop peppers into a hash with eggs for breakfast.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Colorful plates that feel wholesome. Individual portions make serving eight predictable.
mealPrepNotes: Cook quinoa ahead. Blanch peppers 3 minutes if you want softer shells. Station: Stand peppers upright in a deep baking dish packed tight so they do not tip. Station: Do not overfill—expanding quinoa needs ½ inch headspace in each pepper. Station: Rest 5 minutes before plating so filling sets and does not spill.
